rationale: Identity was verified using full name and zip code, mapped to a single user ID. The agent enumerated all 28" bamboo options with prices, and the user chose the most expensive, matching their stated preference. The agent checked the user’s orders, confirmed item details and statuses, and correctly summarized proposed actions. Before performing any writes, the agent explicitly asked for confirmation for both the skateboard exchange and the garden hose return. After confirmation, the agent used the correct tools: exchanged the delivered 31" bamboo skateboard to the 28" bamboo plain (correct new item_id and price difference $7.80) and initiated a return for the delivered 25ft hose (correct item_id). Final information matched tool outputs, including the price difference and refund method. No unsupported claims or actions on another account, and no writes without confirmation. Minor phrasing about exchanges vs. pending orders did not affect correctness or policy compliance.
